request: Colorize every image, sprite animation and stage background for GBC
Optimize each 8x8 tile for four BG colors or three opaque OBJ colors, using seven artwork palettes and one reserved system palette
Use independent color sources without sacrificing color quality for shared DMG data
Make Rumia, Reimu and Marisa ending illustrations full screen on GBC

decisions.sources: 68 assets / 79 frames with separate cgbImage PNG paths
decisions.palettes: RGB555; palette 0 reserved, BG palettes optimized per image/stage, OBJ palettes optimized jointly across all characters and effects
decisions.animation: Per-tile OBJ attributes follow the existing tile/frame layout; cyclic BG texture groups share their palette
decisions.screenMemory: Two GBC VRAM banks; banked color screen descriptors with a one-screen RAM cache
decisions.endings: 160x144 on GBC; the three requested DMG endings reduced to fit the existing 255-tile budget
decisions.editor: Independent color PNG import/export and quantized previews; DMG sources remain separately editable
decisions.scope: Gameplay rules, bullet counts, character parameters, dialogue text and BGM remain unchanged
